Atlas ships computer use in the EU

9 Oct 2026

Contoso Models expanded computer use for Atlas to customers in the European Union. The feature is generally available on the Messages API.

Existing US and UK workspaces keep the same tool-calling contract. No pricing change.

Legacy Completions API sunset date

6 Oct 2026

Contoso Models will deprecate the legacy Completions API on 15 January 2027. Migrate to Messages. This is a breaking API change for remaining Completions callers.
